scope: Eight Google Play Korean descriptions: the same six international samples as English/German, plus Korean publisher Mobirix and Logic Wiz. Descriptive sample, not a verified popularity or search-volume ranking.
method: NFC normalization, lowercase Latin letters, collapse whitespace. Exact contiguous substring counts; Korean particles and nested compounds are not segmented, spelling/spacing variants are not merged. Body between 게임 소개 and 업데이트 날짜, including any public short description. Titles, tags, reviews, screenshots and linked websites excluded. Mobirix's sampled body contains no 스도쿠, so its title is not added to the count. Web pages may be cached or region-dependent. Source prose is not persisted. 킬러 스도쿠 is counted as a complete expression to avoid counting 시간 킬러 as the same game variant.

languageReview.type: Assistant comparison against Korean-language publisher usage and product/UI semantics; not independent native-speaker or commissioned professional review.
decisions: Preserve accurate observed long-tail wording even when less elegant; put core differentiators first and secondary wording in later feature/FAQ paragraphs.
Use 넉넉한 힌트 보상 plus exact reward amounts; do not literally translate generous as 관대한 보상.
출석 보상 describes opening the app each day and is explicitly account/login-free; never describe the seven-day calendar streak as winning seven games.
Use 회 for spendable hint credits; distinguish initial 5+3=8 from a seven-day daily total up to 41.
스마트 힌트, 후보 숫자, 후보 메모, 자동 후보 계산 and actual five Korean difficulty labels are checked against app resources/captures.
Retain spacing variants like 자동 저장/자동저장 and 다크 모드/다크모드; 메모 and 노트 are placed in feature/FAQ context rather than a detached word list.
Korean cognitive-game vocabulary describes genre preference only; no memory or intelligence improvement is promised.
Preserve the genuine screenshot's ellipsized hint labels and English technique parenthesis; no UI repaint or app-code change to fake a cleaner screen.
